features.name: Lead Capture (Follow-Up Offer)
acceptance_criteria: Follow-up offer triggered on every 5th user message (RULE 6 in system prompt)
System asks: Would you like someone from the ChatHealthy.AI team to follow up with you personally?
If user shows interest: collect email, then trigger HIPAA consent flow
Duplicate email detection: if email already exists in DB, do not create new record
Refusal respected: if user declines, do not ask again in same session

test_cases.input: Send 5 messages (greeting, provider search, follow-up, specialty question, another question). Observe if follow-up offer appears.
test_cases.expected: After 5th message, assistant asks if user wants someone to follow up personally
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if follow-up offer appears after 5th user message

test_cases.input: Accept follow-up offer, provide email test_uat_YYYYMMDD@test.com
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if system asks for consent after capturing email

test_cases.input: Try to submit the same email again in a new session
test_cases.expected: Duplicate detected, no new record created
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if system recognizes duplicate and does not create new record

test_cases.input: Decline the follow-up offer. Continue chatting. Observe if offer repeats.
test_cases.expected: System respects refusal and does not re-ask
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if no repeat offer after user declines

features.name: HIPAA Consent Flow (Two-Tier)
acceptance_criteria: System asks Tier 1: May we save a verbatim transcript of this conversation with your contact details?
If Tier 1 declined, system asks Tier 2: May we save a de-identified summary instead?
Tier 1 Yes: full chat_history stored verbatim with consent_verbatim=true
Tier 1 No + Tier 2 Yes: LLM summarizes, deIdentify scrubs PII, stored in notes with consent_summary=true
Both declined: contact fields only, no history stored

test_cases.input: Conversation: ask about providers, provide email when asked. When asked 'May we save a verbatim transcript?' answer YES.
test_cases.expected: Record stored with consent_verbatim=true and full chat_history array
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if MongoDB record has consent_verbatim=true and chat_history is non-empty array

test_cases.input: Same flow, answer NO to verbatim. When asked 'May we save a de-identified summary?' answer YES.
test_cases.expected: Record stored with consent_summary=true, notes contains de-identified summary, no chat_history
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if consent_verbatim=false, consent_summary=true, notes has text, no chat_history field

test_cases.input: Same flow, answer NO to both verbatim and summary.
test_cases.expected: Record stored with email and name only. No chat_history, no notes with conversation content.
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if consent_verbatim=false, consent_summary=false/null, no chat_history

test_cases.input: Provide email, consent verbatim. Verify the consent exchange itself is included in stored chat_history.
test_cases.expected: The consent question and answer are part of the stored transcript (evidence of consent)
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if chat_history contains the consent question and user answer

features.name: Unanswerable Question Handling
acceptance_criteria: When the answer is not in the provided context documents, system calls record_unknown_question BEFORE responding
System does NOT hedge (no 'I think', 'probably', 'might')
Unknown question is stored de-identified in AboutUs.AboutSkip collection
System still provides a helpful response after recording the question

test_cases.input: Ask: What is the capital of France?
test_cases.expected: System calls record_unknown_question (not in context docs), then responds honestly that this is outside its scope
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if question is recorded to DB and response does not use hedging language

test_cases.input: Ask: What medications should I take for my condition?
test_cases.expected: System declines personal medical advice (RULE 3), calls record_unknown_question
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if system declines advice and records the question

test_cases.input: Ask: When was ChatHealthy founded? (answer not in context docs)
test_cases.expected: System calls record_unknown_question rather than guessing
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if system does NOT fabricate an answer and records the question

test_cases.expected: System records unknown question, responds honestly that it does not know
test_cases.pass_fail: Pass if no hedging, question recorded, honest response
